# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the repository root `AGENTS.md` and the project decisions in `docs/DECISIONS.md`. Do not invent backend endpoints or business rules. TONDE Mobile uses Flutter/Dart, Feature-First architecture, Riverpod, GoRouter, Dio and gen-l10n (fr/rn/en). Backend is the source of truth for all queue/ticket logic. Preserve security, offline freshness indicators, tests and quality gates defined in `docs/`.
